import sys,tempfile,ctypes as C,subprocess,json,math
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from experiments.bank_memory_001.test_memory import Tests
from experiments.sram_size_001.native import Native
from experiments.bank_rowwise_001.native import ptr
out={};Tests.setUpClass()
try:
 t=Tests()
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='sram-core-r2-') as d:
  n=Native(t.make(3),t.mean,t.L,d,'tiny','cardinal',True,64);n.initialize(np.zeros(16))
  alias=[]
  for array in ['anchor','point']:
   status=n.lib.initialize(C.byref(n.context),ptr(n.field.packed.values),ptr(n.vector(array)));alias.append({'initialize_from':array,'status':status})
  out['self_alias_initialize']=alias
  n.advance(0,t.obs[:2]);state=n.snapshot().copy();before=n.field.packed.values.copy();first=n.count
  rows=t.obs[:2].copy();rows[1,2]=26
  try:n.advance(first,rows)
  except ValueError:pass
  out['partial_failure']={'poisoned':n.poisoned,'count_unchanged':n.count==first,'history_mutated':not np.array_equal(before,n.field.packed.values),'valid':n.context.qr.lease.valid,'refused':{}}
  ops={'initialize':lambda:n.initialize(np.zeros(16)),'fit':lambda:n.fit(np.zeros(16)),'query':n.query,'scalar':lambda:n.scalar(5),'row':lambda:n.row(np.zeros(16),0),'update':lambda:n.update(np.zeros((1,34))),'restore':lambda:n.restore(state),'advance':lambda:n.advance(first,t.obs[:1])}
  for name,fn in ops.items():
   try:fn();out['partial_failure']['refused'][name]=False
   except ValueError:out['partial_failure']['refused'][name]=True
  so=Path(d)/'math.so';subprocess.run(['cc','-Os','-shared','-fPIC','-fno-fast-math','-ffp-contract=off','experiments/sram_size_001/math_probe.c','-o',str(so)],check=True)
  lib=C.CDLL(str(so));lib.evaluate.argtypes=[C.c_uint,C.c_double,C.c_double];lib.evaluate.restype=C.c_double
  out['tanh_signed_zero']={str(x):math.copysign(1,lib.evaluate(4,x,0)) for x in [0.,-0.]}
  out['tanh_nonzero_sign_and_error']=[{'x':x,'value':lib.evaluate(4,x,0),'libm':math.tanh(x)} for x in [-1e-300,-.25,-1.,-21.,1e-300,.25,1.,21.]]
finally:Tests.tearDownClass()
assert all(out['partial_failure']['refused'].values())
assert out['partial_failure']['poisoned'] and out['partial_failure']['history_mutated'] and out['partial_failure']['count_unchanged'] and not out['partial_failure']['valid']
assert all(a['status']==0 for a in out['self_alias_initialize'])
assert out['tanh_signed_zero']=={'0.0':1.,'-0.0':-1.}
Path('/tmp/sram_core_review_r2_results.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2));print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
